doc_verification.detail: Source URL https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/collections/create-collection is domain_blocked (network restriction), but raw_knowledge.md confirms constraints: hnsw_config.m ∈ [2, 100], hnsw_config.ef_construct ∈ [10, 1000], vectors.size > 0, vectors.distance ∈ [Cosine, Euclidean, Dot, Manhattan]. Version 1.19.x matches target v1.18.2 (major.minor). Endpoint registered in endpoint_registry.

contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: hnsw_config.m >= 2 AND hnsw_config.m <= 100 | hnsw_config.ef_construct >= 10 AND hnsw_config.ef_construct <= 1000 | vectors.size > 0 AND type(vectors.size) = integer | vectors.distance IN [Cosine, Euclidean, Dot, Manhattan]
contract_grounding.note: Violates: m=1,101 and ef=9,1001 accepted with HTTP 200; valid typical (size=128, distance=Euclidean) rejected with HTTP 400. Four range constraints + two type constraints all implicated in Type4 state logic violations.
